SYC.note: A bill only enables regulations for electronic authentication of company filings; no service is authorised, contracted or in use.
Nothing on consumer protection in digital finance.

facts.fact: Bill No. 20 of 2026 refers to the Cybercrimes and other Related Crimes Act, 2021 (Act 59 of 2021) as applying to misuse of data submitted under the new section 10A (Official Gazette).
facts.system: Cybercrimes and other Related Crimes Act, 2021

SYC.note: No use of the law is stated.

facts.fact: Bill No. 20 of 2026 refers to the Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 24 of 2023) as applying to violation or misuse of data submitted under the new section 10A (Official Gazette).

SYC.note: Nothing on revenue collection; the bill covers company registry fees only as a bill.
